item.title: Confessional 1.54.0
item.description: • The thin assistant, properly: pushed narrow, it switches to icons and wraps its controls at every width that needs it.

item.title: Confessional 1.53.0
item.description:
• Screenshots from the right Zoom window: Zoom's home window is never picked, Zoom in a browser is recognised, and a better match found mid-call is switched to.
  • Live captions come back after pausing when the Mac was busy.
  • Easier crash reports (Copy Report to paste into a message) and step-by-step notes to trace crashes; microphone setup better protected.

item.title: Confessional 1.52.0
item.description: • Steadier when your mic changes: if a headset switches into call mode or AirPods connect mid-call, the odd moment of audio is skipped instead of Confessional quitting.

item.title: Confessional 1.51.0
item.description: • A tidier thin assistant: dragged narrow, its buttons become icons and the model controls wrap, instead of running off the edges.

item.title: Confessional 1.50.0
item.description: • Model and thinking in chat: dropdowns beside the cloud / this Mac switch under every chat, just for chat answers.

item.title: Confessional 1.49.0
item.description:
• Search everything: a new Search screen (⌘⇧F or the bar on Home) finds moments by meaning, screenshots, chats, projects and Studio episodes.
  • Ask from a search: a question becomes a chat about the right meeting or project.

item.title: Confessional 1.48.0
item.description:
• Every chat in one list: the Chat screen now lists the chats on meeting and project pages too, with what each is about and a filter.
  • Choose what a chat is about: everything, a meeting, a project, a Studio show or an episode, from the top of the chat.

item.title: Confessional 1.47.0
item.description:
• Deep answers with your tools: turn on “Your tools” beside Deep answer, and Claude can also use your own Claude Code setup (commands, files, skills, plugins, connections), asking you in the chat before each action.
  • Meetings stay protected: anything that names your meetings folder, a private meeting or Confessional's own data is refused; meetings are read through Confessional's tools.

item.title: Confessional 1.46.0
item.description:
• Resize the assistant: drag the line between a meeting and the assistant (double-click for the usual width).
  • Your AI stays where you put it: Confessional no longer switches to Claude by itself when Claude Code appears on your Mac; existing Claude users are unchanged.
  • AI on this Mac: its model shows first in Settings, and messages no longer point you to Claude.

item.title: Confessional 1.45.0
item.description:
• Use your ChatGPT plan (Plus or Pro) for summaries, chat and screenshots, through Codex, with its tools switched off.
  • Use in Other Apps: connect your meetings to the Claude app, Claude Code (one click) and Codex.
  • Plainer words in Settings: AI Models lists your plans, a model on this Mac, then API keys; “Deep answer” in chat; models on this Mac named Small to Largest.
